title: VisionID React and Admin Rewrite

assessment_snapshot.intro: The workspace contains a live-style VisionID company website and a small PHP deployment package:
bullets: The public site is currently a single HTML/CSS/JavaScript page with an existing dark-and-light responsive design, custom CSS variables, and a canvas background.
The current contact endpoint is PHP and sends contact, partner, careers, and chat leads by email; it does not store enquiries in a database.
No React/Vite package, database schema, admin panel, or authentication implementation was detected. Deployment notes target GoDaddy cPanel.
The page already includes basic description metadata and Organization structured data; the requested rewrite also calls for blog SEO and relevant feature images.

proposed_outcome: Rebuild the existing VisionID website as a responsive React + Vite application while retaining its UX/UI, add a secured admin area for managing blog posts and viewing contact enquiries, persist the content and enquiries in a hosted database, publish blog content dynamically on the public site, and implement page-level SEO and relevant feature images. The backend framework, database/provider, deployment target, and migration details need confirmation before the rewrite is planned.
